column1: `order_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '订单编号,代理主键',
`order_no` varchar(24) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单号,业务唯一标识',
`member_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '所属会员编号',
`order_time` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '下单时间',
`items_amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '明细合计金额(派生属性)',
`coupon_discount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '券优惠金额',
`pay_amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '实付金额(派生属性)',
`order_status` varchar(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '待支付' COMMENT '订单状态:待支付/已支付/已完成/已取消/已退款',
`pay_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支付时间,未支付为空',
CONSTRAINT `fk_order_member` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `member` (`member_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,

CONSTRAINT `ck_order_pay_time` CHECK ((((`order_status` in (_utf8mb4'已支付',_utf8mb4'已完成',_utf8mb4'已退款')) and (`pay_time` is not null)) or ((`order_status` in (_utf8mb4'待支付',_utf8mb4'已取消')) and (`pay_time` is null)))),
CONSTRAINT `ck_order_status` CHECK ((`order_status` in (_utf8mb4'待支付',_utf8mb4'已支付',_utf8mb4'已完成',_utf8mb4'已取消',_utf8mb4'已退款')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=600004 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='订单表'
